mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and depresses forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong labor market conditions and robust household demand, which together compress equity risk premiums and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * RSAFS) does not have a statistically significant positive correlation with 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) and accelerating GDP growth (GDPC1) signal sustained demand momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive in periods classified as late-cycle expansion despite positive HOUST and GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply conditions and economic activity, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO growth accelerates (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE falls below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and declines in industrial production signal monetary tightening and weakening supply conditions, which together compress equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * INDPRO) does not have a statistically significant negative correlation with 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC > -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates signal reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, which depress equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative during periods classified as monetary tightening cycles (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).
